english.title: Manufacturer fail to draw up documentation before placing pyrotechnic article (not cat F1/F2/F3 firework) on UK market
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the manufacturer of a pyrotechnic article other than a category F1, F2 or F3 firework, namely **(..SPECIFY PYROTECHNIC ARTICLE..), and placed it on the market having failed to draw up the technical documentation referred to, for a pyrotechnic article in respect of which the conformity assessment procedure in

(A)_[regulation 40(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015 was being carried out, in point 3(c) of Module B]_
(B)_[regulation 40(b) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015 was being carried out, in point 2 of Module G]_
(C)_[regulation 40(c) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015 was being carried out, in point 3.1(b) of Module H]_

of Schedule 2A
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 8(b) , 62(1)(c) and 63(2) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
